summary: Phase 2 (Admin Onboarding Wizard + Department User Provisioning + Force-Password-Change gate + Preview Roles impersonation) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 10/10 passed. Frontend UI: onboarding wizard auto-routes on first admin login, full 'now' happy path (Welcome->Choice->Plotted Project->Provision User with copyable creds->Skip Inventory->Launch->Dashboard) works; 'later' path shows onboarding timeline banner with all step chips and Resume button; force-change-password screen shown for newly provisioned user then redirects to Call List; Preview Roles page lists all users grouped by department, clicking a BDE tile impersonates and shows impersonation banner + Exit preview returns to super admin. Phase 1 RBAC regressions still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: UserController::store hashes with Hash::make() while User model already has 'password' => 'hashed' cast. Cast currently detects bcrypt strings and skips re-hashing, so it works, but relying on both is fragile. Preferred: pass the plain temp password and let the cast hash it (or drop the cast). During testing this was observed to fail once transiently (Hash::check returned false immediately after create); adding a tiny delay resolved it. Likely a rare race/cast interaction — main agent should either remove the explicit Hash::make() in UserController::store or remove the 'hashed' cast to eliminate the double-code-path.
OnboardingController::update does not enforce a reset endpoint; resetting for retesting requires artisan tinker. Consider exposing an admin-only reset for QA parity.
AuthController::impersonate creates a token named 'crm-preview' but does not revoke existing tokens or track impersonator identity. If an audit trail is required, log the impersonator user_id.

context_for_next_testing_agent: OnboardingState needs to be deleted between full-wizard tests: `php artisan tinker --execute="App\Models\OnboardingState::query()->delete();"`. Backend uses Laravel at http://localhost:8000 (NOT REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). BDE role slug is 'sales_bde' (not 'bde'). pytest config uses xdist by default; the phase2 test currently passes both serial and parallel. Login endpoint has throttle:60,1 which is easy to hit on long test loops. Note: intermittent Hash::check failure right after user creation was observed once; if a future flake reappears investigate UserController::store double-hash risk.
rca of the issue: N/A — no user-visible bugs. Only a code-quality concern about redundant Hash::make() combined with 'hashed' cast (see critical_code_review_comments).
